source_paraphrase: Author frames system-design literacy as protection against AI-built apps slowing at higher usage.
decision: ADAPT: add workload and unknowns to existing evidence/decision views.
criticism_or_limit: 10→100→1000 are teaching examples, not measured Spekin thresholds. Latency may be model/network dominated.

source_paraphrase: DNS resolves a hostname before the browser reaches the server.
decision: ADAPT only when explaining a relevant integration/network failure.
criticism_or_limit: Pedagogical simplification; resolver/cache/TLS/proxy failure and private network boundaries remain relevant. Do not add DNS infrastructure.

source_paraphrase: Vertical scaling increases capacity; horizontal scaling distributes requests.
decision: DEFER infrastructure changes; ask for workload, cost and actual bottleneck evidence.
criticism_or_limit: More servers do not repair shared-state, database, provider quota or correctness issues. No mandatory microservices.

source_paraphrase: Cache can reduce repeated database requests.
decision: ADAPT as a decision/tradeoff with accepted-revision keys and invalidation.
criticism_or_limit: Stale acceptance, tenant leakage and ledger errors cost more than a faster cached wrong answer. Measure first.

source_paraphrase: CDN brings content nearer to users across regions.
decision: DEFER unless measured public/static asset delivery needs it.
criticism_or_limit: Private references/manifests need explicit cache access, expiry and purge policy; no public caching of project data.

source_paraphrase: Indexes narrow database lookup rather than scanning all data.
decision: ADAPT: record actual query shape/index and plan evidence in a risky LLD deep dive.
criticism_or_limit: Index benefit depends on selectivity/query plan and adds write/storage/migration cost. Do not cargo-cult the tutorial index.

source_paraphrase: Queue/workers move long processing off the request path.
decision: KEEP existing job/cancel/retry model; reuse current queue before adding a broker.
criticism_or_limit: A queue does not make work instant or imply exactly-once delivery; need bounds, backpressure, timeouts, idempotency, cancellation and reconciliation.

source_paraphrase: Pub/sub decouples an order action from downstream email work.
decision: ADAPT conceptually for revision-impact observations if existing event machinery fits.
criticism_or_limit: Publishing is not proof of delivery/completion; handle ordering, duplicates and missing subscribers. Never infer canonical success from event emitted.

source_paraphrase: Author contrasts monolithic and microservice organization.
decision: SKIP architecture migration; show logical modules separately from deployment units.
criticism_or_limit: Monolith does not mean one undifferentiated module or necessarily one database. Microservices add distributed consistency/observability/operations cost.

source_paraphrase: Build/test and staged delivery are described under CI/CD.
decision: KEEP revision-pinned gates/evidence; allow current VPS/manual gate route.
criticism_or_limit: Build green is not authorization, product correctness or safe release. Delivery and automatic deployment are distinct; no deployment executor in current scope.

source_paraphrase: Closing suggests the concepts as prompts for further AI discussion.
decision: ADAPT to bounded evidence-grounded questions and plain-language explanations.
criticism_or_limit: Do not replace engineering judgment with terminology or a long generic questionnaire.
